tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' bsdu bzhi pa'i don bstan rtsis chen po

zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa bhyo na mo na maḥ don dam rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /gtsang bdag bde chen rtag pa'i mthar thug pa/ /de bzhin nyid la gus pas phyag 'tshal nas/ /dus bzhi gnyis kyi rab dbye rab bshad bya/ /dus bzhi chen po bskal dus bzang ngan te/ /dus bzhi chung ba bstan pa'i bzang ngan yin/ /dang po'i lo ni sa ya phrag bzhi dang*/ /sum 'bum nyi khri'o de yi bcu cha ni/ /rkang pa zhes gsungs rkang pa gcig dang gnyis/ /gsum dang bzhi la rim bzhin rtsod ldan dang*/ /gnyis ldan gsum ldan rdzogs ldan zhes gsungs so/ /dus bzhi chung ba bstan pa'i bzang ngan ni/ /mi lo nyi khri gcig stong drug brgya'i bar/ /de yi bzhi cha dus bzhi so so'i tshad/ /skyon med yon tan tshang ba rdzogs ldan chos/ /de nas bzhi cha nyams pa gsum ldan stod/ /phyed nyams gyur na gsum ldan smad du 'gyur/ /bzhi gsum nyams pa'i lhag ma gnyis ldan yin/ /bzhi cha gcig kyang med na rtsod ldan te/ /lha min kla klo nag po'i chos su gsungs/ /de dang de yi rnam dbye rab shes nas/ /bstan la byi dor bya bar 'dod pa dang*/ /rang gzhan legs pa'i lam la 'jug 'dod pa/ / rdzogs ldan chos mchog dpang gyur gtsug gis blang*/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon dang bcas gyur cing*/ /tshong 'dus 'o ma lta bur bslad pa'i gzhung*/ /gang na 'dug kyang dpang du byar mi rung*/ /gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og mar gnod// grub mtha' gong mas 'og mar gnod pa bzhin/ /rdzogs ldan chos ni dri med rgyal ba'i bka'/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams dang shing rta yi/ /srol 'byed chen po rnams kyis legs gsungs pa/ /skyon med yon tan mchog mnga' rnams yin no/ /de yi lugs la thams cad rang stong min/ /rang stong gzhan stong legs par rnam phye nas/ /kun rdzob gang yin thams cad rang stong dang*/ /don dam gang yin gzhan stong nyid du gsungs/

/gang phyir bden pa gnyis la bden lugs gnyis/ /snang lugs gnyis dang stong lugs gnyis gsungs shing*/ /sgro 'dogs skur 'debs rnam pa mang po dang*/ /'gal 'dus skyon yod skyon med la sogs dang*/ /chos dang chos nyid 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /rgyal khams chen po gnyis su gsungs pa'i phyir/ /bden gnyis ngo bo gcig pa mi srid la// ngo bo tha dad pa yang ma yin zhing*/ /tha dad gtan nas med pa'ang ma yin te/ /ngo bo gcig pa bkag pa'i tha dad do/ /'di nyid la ni ngo bo de nyid dang*/ /gzhan du brjod du med ces gsungs pa ste/ /chos dang chos nyid la yang tshul 'di nyid// 'khor dang myang 'das mtha' dang dbus ma dang*/ /glo bur gnyug ma bcos ma rang bzhin dang*/ /shun pa snying po la yang tshul 'di nyid/ /gsum ldan mar bcad de las gzhan du smra/ /rang rang ngo bos stong pa ma gtogs pa/ /gzhan stong rnams kyis stong nyid go mi chod/ /de phyir don dam chos dbyings de bzhin nyid/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rang bzhin lhan skyes dang*/ /rang bzhin 'gyur med mthar thug chos kyi sku/ /mthar thug sher phyin mthar thug dbu ma dang*/ / mthar thug myang 'das mthar thug byang chub che/ /mthar thug sangs rgyas mthar thug chos dang ni/ /mthar thug dge 'dun mthar thug lha dang sngags/ /mthar thug rgyud dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ /gshis lugs zab mo mthar thug gsungs pa gang*/ /de rnams thams cad rang stong nyid du smra/ /rang stong gang yin don dam bden pa dang*/ /chos dbyings chos nyid de bzhin nyid la sogs// gshis lugs zab mo mthar thug rnams su 'dod/ /bden gnyis rgyal khams gnyis su mi 'byed par/ /snang ba gang yin kun rdzob bden pa dang*/ /stong pa gang yin don dam bden par 'dod/ /snang stong de dag ngo bo dbyer med pas/ / ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad smra/ /'khor 'das rgyal khams gnyis su mi 'byed par/ /snang cha 'khor ba stong cha myang 'das zhes/

/'khor 'das dbyer med don yang de ltar 'dod/ /'gal 'dus skyon yod kun rdzob bden pa dang*// 'gal 'dus skyon med don dam bden pa zhes/ /de ltar rgyal khams gnyis su mi 'byed par/ /snang stong gang yin bden pa gnyis su smra/ /rtog ge can gyi spyod yul 'khor ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor can gyi spyod yul myang 'das zhes/ /de ltar rgyal khams gnyis su mi 'byed par/ /snang stong gnyis la 'khor 'das don du 'dod/ /snang tshad kun rdzob 'khor ba yin na ni/ /don dam snang ba'ang kun rdzob 'khor bar 'gyur/ /stong tshad don dam myang 'das yin na ni/ /rang stong thams cad don dam myang 'das 'gyur/ /'dod na sdug bsngal kun 'byung thams cad kyang*/ /don dam myang 'das yin par thal bar 'gyur/ /de yang 'dod na zag med yin par 'gyur/ /gtsang bdag bde chen rtag pa'ang yin par 'gyur/ /gang gā'i klung gi rdul snyed don dam gyi/ /stobs sogs yon tan kun yang tshang bar 'gyur/ /de dag blang bya'i mthar thug yin par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i mgon skyabs mthar thug yin par 'gyur/ /mi shigs rdo rje'i sku yang yin par 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i lha sngags rgyud kyang yin par 'gyur/ /stong pa chen po 'gyur med lnga dang ni/ /thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug la sogs/ /gshis lugs zab mo'i e waṃ mthar thug dang*/ /a haṃ mthar thug haṃ kṣa mthar thug dang*/ /rdo rje pad ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ /rdo rje bha ga rdo rje rtse mo dang*/ /rdo rje dbyings dang thig le gru gsum dang*/ /rdo rje'i ā li kā li la sogs pa/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma'i chos kun yin par 'gyur/ /gnyen pos spang du gtan nas mi rung 'gyur/ /de yang don du lam bden don med 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thob pa gtan nas mi srid 'gyur/ /chos dang dge 'dun rnams kyang mi srid 'gyur/ / 'di la nyes skyon gzhan yang dpag med do/ /bden gnyis 'khor 'das ngo bo gcig na ni/

/bde gshegs snying po glo bur dri ma dang*/ /'bral du rung ngam mi rung brtag par mdzod/ /glo bur dri ma gzhom du rung ba ltar/ /bde gshegs snying po'ang gzhom du rung ngam ci/ /glo bur dri ma 'dus byas yin pa ltar/ /bde gshegs snying po'ang 'dus byas yin nam ci/ /glo bur dri ma kun rdzob yin pa ltar/ /bde gshegs snying po'ang kun rdzob yin nam ci/ /glo bur dri ma kun brtags yin pa ltar/ /bde gshegs snying po'ang kun brtags yin nam ci/ /glo bur dri ma phyi nang yin pa ltar/ /bde gshegs snying po'ang phyi nang yin nam ci/ / bde gshegs snying po don dam yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang don dam yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po rtag pa yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang rtag pa yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po yongs grub yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang yongs grub yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po sangs rgyas yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang sangs rgyas yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po rang byung yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang rang byung yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po ye shes yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang ye shes yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po rnam mkhyen yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang rnam mkhyen yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po chos dbyings yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang chos dbyings yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po bde chen yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang bde chen yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po myang 'das yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang myang 'das yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po sher phyin yin pa ltar/ / glo bur dri ma'ang sher phyin yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po dbu ma yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang dbu ma yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po gzhan stong yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang gzhan stong yin nam ci/

/bde gshegs snying po stong gzhi yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang stong gzhi yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po gzhan mchog yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang gzhan mchog yin nam ci// bde gshegs snying po 'gog bden yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang 'gog bden yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po 'gog gzhi yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang 'gog gzhi yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po bral gzhi yin pa ltar// glo bur dri ma'ang bral gzhi yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po dben gzhi yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang dben gzhi yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po dag gzhi yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang dag gzhi yin nam ci/ /bde gshegs snying po med gzhi yin pa ltar/ /glo bur dri ma'ang med gzhi yin nam ci/ /de ltar 'dod na nyes skyon dpag med do/ /rdzogs ldan lugs la nyes skyon de rnams med/ /shes bya thams cad dngos po dngos med du/ /'dus par 'dod pa gsum ldan mar bcad lugs/ /chos nyid dbu ma shes bya'i mchog yin yang*/ /dngos po dngos med gang yang ma yin gyi/ /phung po gsum par bzhed pa rdzogs ldan lugs/ /de phyir thams cad dngos po dngos med du/ /'dus pa min te phung gsum yod pa'i phyir/ /thams cad bem rig gnyis su kha tshon chod/ /de phyir de la phung po gsum pa med/ /ces pa 'di ni rdzogs ldan chos lugs yin/ / gsum ldan mar bcad chos nyid de bzhin nyid/ /bem rig gang yang min pa'i phung gsum 'dod/ /gal te chos dbyings rig pa ma yin na/ /dbyings rig dbyer med ye shes gang la bgyi/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes gang la bgyi/ / don dam rang byung ye shes gang la bgyi/ /don dam so so rang rig mi g.yo ba/ / don dam bdag rig gzhan rig thams cad la/ /don dam kun shes kun rig dam pa po/ /don dam khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /don dam ye shes sku ste rang byung ba/

/don dam thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtsho/ /don dam kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa/ /don dam ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/ / don dam ye shes ldan la yod med shes/ /don dam ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang*/ /don dam kun tu bzang po blo gros bzang*/ /don dam sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po che/ /don dam mchod pa chen po 'dod chags che/ /don dam mchod pa chen po zhe sdang che/ /don dam mchod pa chen po gti mug che/ /don dam mchod pa chen po khro ba che/ /don dam mchod pa chen po chags pa che/ /don dam 'dod pa chen po bde ba che/ /don dam dga' ba chen po mgu ba che/ /don dam mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang*/ /don dam sgyu 'phrul chen po dga' bas dga'/ /don dam bsam gtan chen po'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /don dam shes rab chen po'i lus 'chang ba/ /don dam smon lam ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /don dam byams chen rang bzhin dpag tu med/ /don dam snying rje chen po blo yi mchog /don dam shes rab chen po blo chen ldan/ /don dam mkhas pa chen po thabs che ba/ /don dam shes bcu rnam dag bdag nyid can/ /don dam shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po/ /don dam shes pa 'ba' zhig nges gsal ba/ /don dam shes pa brgyad po rtogs pa 'chang*/ /don dam shes rab ye shes me bo che/ /don dam ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /don dam ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /don dam sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /don dam sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad che/ /don dam rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren/ /don dam gsum rig gtsang ma dag pa ste/ /don dam mngon shes drug ldan rjes dran drug /don dam shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mchog /don dam thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag /don dam 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /don dam ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces sogs rnam pa mang po don dam ni/ /shes pa rig pa ye shes yin par ston/

/de phyir skad cig las 'das ye shes ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi mthar thug de kho na/ /nyid ces rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs pa yin/ /gal te don dam rig pa ma yin na/ /don dam chos sku ngo bo nyid sku dag /rig pa min phyir kun mkhyen min par 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen min na sangs rgyas min par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas min na chos sku min par 'gyur/ /'dod na chos can dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /gal te don dam rig pa yin na ni/ /'dus ma byas kyi rig pa khur nas 'ong*/ /rtag cing brtan pa'i rig pa'ang khur nas 'ong*/ / ther zug g.yung drung rig pa'ang khur nas 'ong*/ /bde gshegs snying po rig pa'ang khur nas 'ong*/ /yongs grub dgu yi rig pa'ang de bzhin no/ /gal te don dam shes pa ma yin na/ /gshis lugs zab mo ston pa'i rdzogs ldan chos// mdo rgyud zab mo kun dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /gal te don dam shes pa yin na ni/ /'dus byas mi rtag par yang 'gyur zhe na/ /de 'dra gsum ldan mar bcad lugs yin gyi/ /rdzogs ldan chos mchog khyad 'phags lugs la ni/ /shes pa la yang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /rig pa la yang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas// ye shes la yang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /dkon mchog gsum sogs kun la'ang bden gnyis dang*/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas su phye nas gsungs/ /mi rtag pa dang rtag par phye nas gsungs/ /rang stong gzhan stong legs par phye nas gsungs/ /rnam shes ye shes legs par phye nas gsungs/ /gzhan byung rang byung legs par phye nas gsungs/ /chos dang chos nyid mtha' dbus phye nas gsungs/ /bcos ma rang bzhin legs par phye nas gsungs/ /glo bur gnyug ma legs par phye nas gsungs/ /kun brtags yongs grub legs par phye nas gsungs/ /rjes thob mnyam bzhag legs par phye nas gsungs/ /shan 'byed la zlo legs par phye nas gsungs/ /dbyer yod dbyer med legs par phye nas gsungs/ /'khrul lugs gshis lugs legs par phye nas gsungs/

/'dod lugs yin lugs legs par phye nas gsungs/ /srol 'byed srol 'gog legs par phye nas gsungs/ /phung gsum yod med legs par phye nas gsungs/ /dus bzhi che chung legs par phye nas gsungs/ /chung ba la yang rdzogs ldan chos mchog dang*/ /gsum ldan mar bcad dman par rab phye nas// dpang du rung dang mi rung phye nas gsungs/ /ngo bo nyid gsum legs par phye nas gsungs/ /bdag gsum rnam dbye legs par phye nas gsungs/ /stong nyid gsum gyi rnam dbye phye nas gsungs/ /phyi nang gzhan mchog legs par phye nas gsungs/ /bden bzhi chos bzhi chos lnga la sogs pa/ /legs par phye ba'i chos 'khor gsungs pa ltar/ /rdzogs ldan chos mchog rnams la goms byas na/ /mtshungs pa med pa'i mkhas pa chen por 'gyur/ /rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad dgyes par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur/ / rdzogs ldan chos mchog khyad par 'phags rnams su/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor lha dang sngags dang rgyud/ /rigs kyi dbye bsdu ji snyed gsungs pa kun/ / dbyings rig dbyer med don dam 'dus ma byas/ /cha med kun 'gro khyab bdag yin mod kyang*/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can rnams na re/ /de rnams thams cad 'dus byas yin no lo/ /'o na de rnams kun rdzob yin par 'gyur/

/ mthar thug gtan gyi skyabs mchog min par 'gyur/ /brdzun pa slu ba'i chos kyang yin par 'gyur/ /snying po'i mdo lnga mdo bcu la sogs su/ /mthar thug skyabs mchog gsum po thams cad kyang*/ /rtag brtan ther zug g.yung drung 'dus ma byas/ /don dam bden par yang yang gsungs pas gnod/ /gsungs pa de rnams drang don yin zhe na/ /drang don yin pa'i shes byed 'ga' yang med// gnod byed lung rigs rnam dag shin tu mang*/ /de phyir log bshad de 'dra spong gyur cig /gal te de rnams thams cad kun rdzob yin/ /don dam bden pa cir yang ma grub pas/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor sogs kyang min zhe na/ /khyab byed khegs na khyab bya khegs phyir dang*/ /rten khegs na yang brten pa khegs pa'i phyir/ /don dam khegs na kun rdzob khegs 'gyur la/ /chos nyid khegs na chos rnams khegs 'gyur zhing*/ /dbus ma khegs na mtha' ma khegs 'gyur la/ /yongs grub khegs na kun brtags khegs 'gyur zhing*/ /rang bzhin khegs na bcos ma khegs 'gyur la/ /gnyug ma khegs na glo bur khegs 'gyur zhing*/ /gzhan stong khegs na rang stong khegs 'gyur la/ /snying po khegs na dri ma khegs 'gyur zhing*/ /gtsang ba khegs na mi gtsang khegs 'gyur la/ /bdag mchog khegs na chos kun khegs 'gyur zhing*/ /bde chen khegs na sdug bsngal khegs 'gyur la/ /rtag pa khegs na mi rtag khegs 'gyur zhing*/ /sangs rgyas med na sems can med par 'gyur/ /ye shes med na rnam shes med par 'gyur/ /rang byung med na gzhan byung med par 'gyur/ /gzhan mchog med na phyi nang med par 'gyur/ /'gog bden med na bden pa med par 'gyur/ /sbyang gzhi med na sbyang bya sbyong byed dang*/ /sbyangs 'bras la sogs gang yang med par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nyid ni gal te med gyur na/ /ming sogs chos gzhan kun yang med par 'gyur/ /'di 'dra gzhan yang shin tu mang bar yod/ /de phyir 'gro ba kun la rdzogs ldan gyi/

/chos mchog zab mo'i byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig / shes bya la ni 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /bem rig gnyis su 'byed pa rdzogs ldan lugs/ /bem po la yang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /rig pa la yang 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /shes pa la yang rnam shes ye shes dang*/ /ye shes la yang rang byung gzhan byung dang*/ /rtag pa dang ni mi rtag ye shes dang*/ /'dus ma byas dang 'dus byas ye shes dang*/ /legs par 'byed pa rdzogs ldan lugs la yod/ /de phyir chos dbyings ye shes gang yin te/ /rtag pa 'dus ma byas kyi ye shes dang*/ /don dam dbyings rig dbyer med ye shes dang*/ /'gal 'dus skyon med dpe bral ye shes dang*/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*// rang bzhin 'gyur med yongs grub ye shes dang*/ /rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i ye shes yin/ /rdzogs ldan chos mchog khyad par 'phags rnams su/ /chos dbyings de bzhin nyid la mthar thug gi /sher phyin zab mor gsungs pa gang yin rnams/ /rtag pa 'dus ma byas kyi ye shes dang*/ /stong pa chen po 'gyur med lnga dang ni/ /rtag pa 'dus ma byas kyi rgyal ba lnga/ /rtag brtan ther zug g.yung drung rig ma lnga/ /sangs rgyas lnga bdag sangs rgyas sku lnga dang*/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag dang ni/ /shes bcu rnam dag bdag la dgongs pa yin/ /gsum ldan mar bcad de skad mi smra ste/ /shes rab gang yin 'dus byas dngos po yin/ /de phyir sher phyin zab mo mthar thug kyang*/ /'dus byas mi rtag skad cig mar yang 'dod/ /de'i kyang lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo bar byas/ /rgyu la skyed byed dang ni bral byed kyi/ /rgyal khams gnyis su 'byed pa mi shes par/ / rgyu rnams thams cad skyed byed kho nar 'dod/ /'bras bu la yang skyed 'bras bral 'bras kyi/ /rgyal khams gnyis su 'byed pa mi shes par/ /'bras bu gang yin bskyed 'bras kho nar 'dod/ /de phyir rtag pa'i rgyu 'bras mi 'dod cing*/

/ 'dus ma byas kyi rgyu 'bras mi 'dod la/ /rgyu 'bras ngo bo gcig pa mi 'dod cing*/ /gzhi 'bras ngo bo gcig pa'ang mi 'dod la/ /rgyu 'bras gzhan mchog pha rol mi 'dod pa'ang*/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can bslad pa'i lugs/ / rdzogs ldan la ni de dang de dag las/ /bzlog pa'i chos lugs khyad par 'phags pa yod/ /kun gzhi la yang rnam shes ye shes dang*/ /kun rdzob don dam chos dang chos nyid dang*/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas su 'byed pa dang*/ / sbyang bya dang ni sbyang gzhir 'byed pa dang*/ /glo bur ba dang gnyug mar 'byed pa dang*/ /bcos ma rang bzhin 'khrul lugs gshis lugs dang*/ /shun pa snying po mi rtag rtag pa dang*/ /mtha' dang dbus su 'byed pa la sogs pa'i/ /rnam gzhag legs po rdzogs ldan lugs la yod/ /gsum ldan mar bcad de 'dra'i chos skad nub/ /kun gzhi gang yin ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /len pa'i rnam shes nyid la 'dod pa byung*/ /des kyang lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo bar byas/ /bde gshegs snying por gsungs pa'i kun gzhi dang*/ /zag med dge bar gsungs pa'i kun gzhi dang*/ /sa rnams sna tshogs yin pa'i kun gzhi dang*/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal yin pa'i kun gzhi ni/ /'gyur med yongs grub dbu ma chen po dang*/ /myang 'das chen po phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /byang chub chen po e waṃ mthar thug dang*/ /dus 'khor mthar thug bde dgyes mthar thug dang*/ /gsang 'dus la sogs lha sngags rgyud kun dang*/ /dkyil 'khor mthar thug la sogs mthar thug kun/ /kun nas 'dus pa du ma ro gcig dbyings/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha' la dgongs/ /de nyid dang po'i sangs rgyas ris med dang*/ /gdod nas grol ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ /gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa'i 'gog bden dang*/ /bden don bcu gnyis de nyid bcu drug dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' don dam byang chub sems/ /'dus ma byas kyi stong nyid snying rje

dang*/ /rtag cing brtan pa'i thabs shes dbyer med dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas kyang yin/ /gsum ldan mar bcad de 'dra'i rnam gzhag nub/ /des kyang lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo bar byas/ /rdzogs ldan chos mchog khyad 'phags rnams su ni/ /rgyud sder rgyu yi rgyud ces gsungs pa rnams/ /bde gshegs snying po kun gzhi ye shes la/ /dgongs pa yin gyi kun gzhi rnam shes la/ /dgongs pa gtan nas min te gang gi phyir/ /rgyud sde zab mo gang yin chos kyi dbyings/ /don dam 'dus ma byas la gsungs phyir dang*/ /kun gzhi rnam shes yin na don dam min/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma 'dus ma byas kyang min/ / gtsang bdag bde chen rtag pa'i mchog kyang min/ /rang bzhin rigs dang ngo bo nyid sku'ang min/ /yongs grub dgu'am bcu gnyis gang yang min/ /de rnams min na gshis lugs zab mo yi/ /lha sngags rgyud dang dkyil 'khor gang yang min/ /gzhi 'bras dbyer med rgyud kyang ma yin no/ /de rnams min na rang bzhin 'od gsal min/ /rang bzhin lhan skyes bde ba'ang ma yin la/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas sogs kyang ma yin pas/ /rgyu yi rgyud dang 'bras bu'i rgyud kyang min/ /kun gzhi rnam shes rang bzhin 'od gsal du/ /bzhed pa rnams la bdag ni ma phod pas/ /thal mo sbyar nas gros 'debs zhu ba 'bul/ /kun gzhi rnam shes ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /glo bur dri mas bsdus pa yin phyir dang*/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal dag pa yin phyir dang*/ /dri ma gdod nas dag pa yin phyir ro/ /kun gzhi rnam shes 'dus byas yin phyir dang*/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dus ma byas yin phyir/ /rnam shes yin na rang bzhin 'od gsal min// rnam shes yin na rang byung ye shes min/ /rnam shes yin na rtag brtan ther zug min/ /rnam shes yin na bde gshegs snying po min/ /rnam shes yin na dbu ma chen po min/ /rnam shes yin na phyag rgya chen po min/

/rnam shes yin na myang 'das chen po min/ /rnam shes yin na lhan cig skyes sku min/ /rnam shes yin na sher phyin zab mo min/ /rnam shes yin na gzhan stong zab mo min/ /rnam shes yin na yongs grub thams cad min/ /de rnams min na rgyu yi rgyud kyang min/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal yin na rnam shes min/ /rnam shes min na kun gzhi rnam shes min/ /ye shes rnam shes snang mun ji bzhin dang*/ /bdud rtsi dang ni dug bzhin gnas pa'i phyir/ /de dag gzhi mthun gtan nas mi srid pas/ / de dag gcig tu bsre bar ma gyur cig /gal te bsres na sangs rgyas bstan pa ni/ /nyams par byas kyis gsal bar byas pa min/ /rdzogs ldan chos mchog khyad par 'phags rnams su/ /sbyang gzhi kun gzhi ye shes nam mkha' 'dra/ / sbyang bya glo bur dri ma sprin dang 'dra/ /sbyong byed lam bden mi bzad rlung dang 'dra/ /sbyangs 'bras bral 'bras sprin sangs nam mkha' 'dra/ /de ltar gsungs kyang de la mi mkhas pa/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can mang po ni/ /sbyang bya dang ni sbyang gzhi gcig tu 'dod/ /sprin dang nam mkha' gcig tu 'dod dang mtshungs/ /'dir ni sbyang gzhi dri bcas de bzhin nyid/ /kun gzhi ye shes 'dus ma byas yin la/ /sbyang bya dri ma 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/ /de gnyis gcig gam mi gcig dgongs par zhu/ /sbyang gzhi rtag pa sbyang bya mi rtag pa/ /de gnyis gcig gam mi gcig dgongs par zhu/ /sbyang gzhi zag med sbyang bya zag pa yin/ /de gnyis gcig gam mi gcig dgongs par zhu/ /sbyang gzhi rnam byang sbyang bya kun nyon mongs/ /de gnyis gcig gam mi gcig dgongs par zhu/ /de 'dra gzhan yang shin tu mang bar mchis/ /yongs grub dbu ma ming tsam tha dad kyi/ /don la tha dad med pa rdzogs ldan lugs/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can lugs la ni/ /'gyur med yongs grub sems tsam kho nar 'dod/ /rang bzhin gsum ga'ang sems tsam kho na lo/

/skyon med rdzogs ldan dbu ma'i gzhung rnams su/ /ngo bo nyid gsum yang yang gsungs phyir dang*/ /sems tsam gzhung du de skad ma gsungs shing*/ /de la gnod byed mang po yod pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid gsum dbu ma kho na yi/ /chos lugs yin par rdzogs ldan lugs las byung*/ /de phyir de 'dra'i rnam gzhag ma shes shing*/ /rnam par 'khrugs pas lta ba'i snyigs ma byung*/ /yongs grub la sogs rang bzhin gsum ston pa'i/ /dbu ma rnams kyang sems tsam gzhung du phab/ /de ston mkhas pa chen po dbu ma pa// chen po dag kyang sems tsam pa ru phab/ /don dam dbu ma cir yang ma grub ces/ /ston pa'i gzhung ngan skur 'debs mthar lhung zhing*/ /med pa chad pa'i phyogs su lhung rnams la/ /dbu ma yin zhes bstod bkur bsngags byed pa/ /de ma yin la der 'dzin bdud kyi tshig /gsum ldan mar bcad byung gi rdzogs ldan la/ /de 'dra'i lta ngan ri bong rwa dang mtshungs/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can rnams na re/ /don dam bden pa cir yang ma grub kyang*/ /kun rdzob las 'bras slu ba med pa'i phyir/ /yod med sgro skur mtha' las grol zhe na/ /don dam med pa'i kun rdzob srid lags sam/ /khyab byed med pa'i khyab bya srid lags sam/ /gzhi rten med pa'i brten pa srid lags sam/ /gnyug ma med pa'i glo bur srid lags sam/ /chos nyid med pa'i chos can srid lags sam// srid na chos nyid kun 'gro ma lags sam/ /gal te don dam med pa mi srid na// don dam cir ma grub dang mi 'gal lam/ /dbu ma pa ni rang rgyud thal 'gyur zhes/ /'byed pa dbu ma'i dbye bar mi rung ste/ /de bzhin nyid kyi dbye bar mi rung phyir/ /de 'dra rdzogs ldan gzhung du ma gsungs kyang*/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can gzhung du byung*/ /des kyang lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo bar byas/ / rdzogs ldan lugs la dbu ma'i dbye ba ni/ /yongs grub dgu la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang*/

/rgyud sder gsungs pa'i rigs kyi dbye ba dang*/ /don dam mtshan brjod rgyud du legs gsungs pa'i/ /mtshan gyi dbye bas bstan pa thams cad kyang*/ /mtha' bral dbu ma chen po dbye ba yin/ /de bzhin gshis lugs zab mo mthar thug gi /dbye ba ji snyed gsungs pa thams cad kyang*/ /mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i dbye bar 'gyur/ /'di la 'dus byas gcig kyang 'dres pa med/ /chos dbyings 'dus ma byas kyi dbye bar 'gyur/ /'di la mi rtag 'dres pa cung zad med/ /rtag brtan ther zug dbyings kyi dbye bar 'gyur/ /'di la kun rdzob gcig kyang 'dres pa med/ / don dam yongs grub kho na'i dbye ba ni// ngo bo dbye ba cung zad tsam yang med/ /ming dang rnam pa'i dbye ba shin tu mang*/ / gang phyir chos dbyings du ma ro gcig don/ /ming ni du ma don ni ro gcig dang*/ /rnam pa du ma ngo bo ro gcig go /de phyir 'di ni sher phyin mthar thug dang*/ /myang 'das chen po phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /shin tu rnal 'byor rdo rje rnal 'byor dang*/ /lhan cig skyes sbyor dus 'khor bde dgyes sogs/ /zab mo mthar thug kun gyi dbye bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes na gcig shes kun shes yin/ /gshis lugs zab mo mthar thug thams cad la/ /rmongs pa med pa'i mkhas pa chen po 'gyur/ /rang rgyud thal 'gyur gnyis ka 'dus byas yin/ /de phyir de dag dngos po'i mthar lhung zhing*/ /yod pa'i phyogs su chad phyir dbu ma min/ /dbu ma min pa dbu ma'i dbye gzhi dang*/ /phye ba'i ya gyal gang du yang mi rung ste/ /tshad ma min pa tshad ma'i dbye gzhi dang*/ /phye ba'i ya gyal gang du'ang mi rung bzhin/ /bden pa min pa bden pa'i dbye gzhi dang*/ /phye ba'i ya gyal gang du'ang mi rung bzhin/ /rdzogs ldan lugs ni de ltar yin mod kyang*/ / gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can rnams na re/ /mtha' dang bral ba tsam la dbu ma zhes/ /btags par zad kyi don la dbu ma med/

/dbu ma'ang dbu mas stong pa yin phyir lo/ /de lta yin na don dam chos sku dang*/ /ngo bo nyid sku lhan cig skyes sku dang*/ /rtag brtan ther zug g.yung drung mkha' khyab kyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun thams cad la/ /skur ba btab pas sdig lta chen por 'gyur/ /gang phyir de rnams rang gis mi stong pa'i/ /gzhan stong zab mo yin par gsungs phyir ro/ /mdo rgyud rnam dag zab mo thams cad du/ /stong nyid zab mo gsungs pa thams cad ni/ /sgro skur gnyis kyi stong pa'i gzhi la dgongs/ /de bzhin yod med gnyis kyis stong gzhi dang*/ /dngos po dngos med gnyis kyis stong gzhi dang*/ /kun rdzob kun gyis stong pa'i gzhi la dgongs/ /stong gzhi de nyid bde gshegs snying po dang*/ /rang bzhin rigs dang rang bzhin sangs rgyas dang*/ /rang bzhin chos dang rang bzhin dge 'dun dang*// rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /rang bzhin lha dang rang bzhin rgyud dang sngags/ /rang bzhin myang 'das rang bzhin 'od gsal dang*/ / rang bzhin gyis dag gdod nas rnam dag dang*/ /rnam par dag pa'i gzugs nas rnam mkhyen par/ /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub kyi/ /gzugs nas sangs rgyas chos kyi bar la sogs/ /'dus ma byas kyi stobs bcu la sogs pa/ /yon tan mtha' yas tshang ba'i de bzhin nyid/ /gzhi yi sangs rgyas dang po'i sangs rgyas yin/ /gdod nas grol ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/

/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gzod nas rnam grol thugs/ /sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas kyang yin/ /de phyir de bzhin nyid sogs legs ston pa'i/ /mdo rgyud zab mo kun gyi mthar thug ni/ /gzhan stong yin gyi rang stong gtan ma yin/ /don dam yin gyi kun rdzob gtan ma yin/ /chos nyid yin gyi chos rnams gtan ma yin/ /dbus ma yin gyi mtha' ma gtan ma yin/ /myang 'das yin gyi 'khor ba gtan ma yin/ /ye shes yin gyi rnam shes gtan ma yin/ /gtsang ba yin gyi mi gtsang gtan ma yin/ /bdag mchog yin gyi cang med gtan ma yin/ /bde chen yin gyi sdug bsngal gtan ma yin/ /rtag brtan yin gyi mi rtag gtan ma yin/ /rang byung yin gyi gzhan byung gtan ma yin/ /yongs grub yin gyi kun brtags gtan ma yin/ /rang bzhin yin gyi bcos ma gtan ma yin/ /gnyug ma yin gyi glo bur gtan ma yin/ /sangs rgyas yin gyi sems can gtan ma yin/ /snying po yin gyi shun pa gtan ma yin/ /nges don yin gyi drang don gtan ma yin/ /mthar thug yin gyi gnas skabs gtan ma yin/ / gzhi 'bras yin gyi lam bden gtan ma yin/ /sbyang gzhi yin gyi sbyang bya gtan ma yin/ /gshis lugs yin gyi 'khrul lugs gtan ma yin/ /gzhan mchog yin gyi phyi nang gtan ma yin/ /bden pa yin gyi brdzun pa gtan ma yin/ /yang dag yin gyi log pa gtan ma yin/ /stong gzhi yin gyi stong tsam gtan ma yin// bral gzhi yin gyi bral tsam gtan ma yin/ /med gzhi yin gyi med tsam gtan ma yin/ /sgrub chos yin gyi med dgag gtan ma yin/ /dge ba yin gyi mi dge gtan ma yin/ /tshad ma yin gyi tshad min gtan ma yin/ /rigs pa yin gyi mi rigs gtan ma yin/ /dri med yin gyi dri ma gtan ma yin/ /de phyir de dag dbu ma chen por mtshungs/ /chos 'khor gsum pa'i mdo mchog thams cad dang*/ /byams chos thams cad dbu ma chen por mtshungs/ /rnam dag rgyud sde rnams kyang de bzhin no/

/gsum ldan mar bcad mkhas pa phal na re/ /kun rdzob rten 'brel dbu ma chen po ste/ /dbu ma gang yin rten 'brel yin no lo/ / de lta yin na 'dus byas mi rtag pa'ang*/ /rten 'brel yin pas dbu ma yin par 'gyur/ /'dod na don dam chos dbyings yin par 'gyur/ /de yang 'dod na 'dus ma byas su 'gyur/ /'dod na chos can dang yang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /de phyir rten cing 'brel 'byung gsungs pa la/ /bden gnyis rnam dbye rdzogs ldan chos las gsungs/ /kun rdzob rten 'brel legs par rtogs pa ni/ /dbu ma chen po'i grong du 'jug pa'i lam/ /don dam rten 'brel chos dbyings zab mo ni/ /rten 'brel 'di min rten 'brel gzhan mchog yin/ /yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton pa yin/ /dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang ba yin/ / bden don bcu gnyis gnas sogs bcu gnyis yin/ /dus sbyor nyi ma'i dbugs rnams 'gags pa yin/ /yum dang phal chen sngags las gsungs pa yin/ /rdzogs ldan mkhas mchog rnams kyis gsungs pa yin/ /gsum ldan mar bcad phal gyi spyod yul min/ /de rnams sems tsam min pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /mtha' bral stong gzhi phung gsum yin phyir dang*/ /sems tsam yin na dngos smra yin pa'i phyir/ /stong gzhi de rnams rnam shes chos las 'das/ / gnyis med ye shes tshul 'chang yin phyir dang*/ /skad cig gcig dang du ma dang bral phyir/ /de dag dngos smra'i chos su ga la rung*/ /chos 'khor gnyis pa'i don yang de bzhin nyid/ /yon tan dpag yas tshang ba yin pa'i phyir/ /med dgag ma yin de phyir rang stong dang*/ /cang med stong pa chad pa'i stong pa min/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong gzhi yin phyir dang*/ /'gyur med mchog gi bde chen yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i phyag rgya che/ /don dam e waṃ yi ge yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes sku/ /don dam thig le gru gsum yin phyir dang*/

/pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje'i sku/ /don dam rdo rje bha ga yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i sngags kyi sku// don dam ā li kā li yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i g.yung drung sku/ /don dam rdo rje pad ma yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i ther zug sku/ /don dam rdo rje'i zla nyi yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i chos nyid sku/ /don dam rdo rje'i khu rdul yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje'i dbyings/ /don dam cha med kun 'gro yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i sngags kyi dbyings/ /don dam rnam bcu dbang ldan yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i bde ba'i dbyings// don dam lus med rdo rje yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i dbu ma che/ /don dam rdo rje snying po yin phyir dang*/ /pra phab brgyad dang mtshungs pa'i rdo rje 'chang*/ /don dam rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs dang*/ /don dam rgyal ba'i yum gyur sher phyin sogs/ /zab mo mthar thug thams cad yin phyir ro/ /de phyir rgyal yum rgyas 'bring bsdus la sogs/ /chos 'khor gnyis pa'i stong nyid zab mo dang*/ /snying po'i mdo lnga mdo bcu la sogs pa/ /chos 'khor gsum pa'i stong nyid zab mo dang*/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i stong nyid zab mo ste/ /mdo rgyud zab mo'i stong nyid zab mo kun/ /kun rdzob ma yin don dam bden pa yin/ / 'dus byas ma yin 'dus ma byas dbyings yin/ /mi brtan ma yin rtag brtan ther zug yin/ /brdzun pa ma yin bden pa yang dag yin/ /slu ba ma yin bslu med skyabs mchog yin/ /'gyur ba ma yin 'gyur med yongs grub yin/ /tshad ma 'di min don dam tshad ma yin/ /rig pa 'di min chos nyid rig pa yin/ / sems tsam 'di min sems tsam gzhan mchog yin/ /rang rig 'di min rang rig gzhan mchog yin/

/rang gsal 'di min rang gsal gzhan mchog yin// rnam rig 'di min rnam rig gzhan mchog yin/ /rnam shes ma yin rang byung ye shes yin/ /kun brtags ma yin yongs grub ye shes yin/ /dngos smra ma yin dbu ma chen po yin/ /bem po ma yin kun shes kun rig yin/ /rnam rtog ma yin mi rtog ye shes yin/ /rtog ge ma yin rnal 'byor spyod yul yin/ /phung po 'di min phung po gzhan mchog yin/ /khams kyang 'di min khams gzhan pha rol mchog /skye mched 'di min skye mched gzhan mchog yin/ /las dbang 'di min las dbang gzhan mchog yin/ /'di yi bya ba rnams kyang de bzhin no/ / khams gsum 'di min khams gsum gzhan mchog yin/ /srid gsum 'di min srid gsum gzhan mchog yin/ /dus gsum 'di min dus gsum gzhan mchog yin/ /theg gsum 'di min theg gsum gzhan mchog yin/ /brtan g.yo 'di min brtan g.yo gzhan mchog yin/ /rgyu 'bras 'di min rgyu 'bras gzhan mchog yin/ /skye 'gag 'di min skye 'gag gzhan mchog yin/ /snang stong 'di min snang stong gzhan mchog yin/ /gtso 'khor 'di min gtso 'khor gzhan mchog yin/ /yab yum 'di min yab yum gzhan mchog yin/ /pho mo 'di min pho mo gzhan mchog yin/ /ma ning 'di min ma ning gzhan mchog yin// rten 'brel 'di min rten 'brel gzhan mchog yin/ /phar phyin 'di min phar phyin gzhan mchog yin/ /stong nyid 'di min stong nyid gzhan mchog yin/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams thams cad kyang*/ /lam bden 'di min don dam 'gog bden yin/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bsam gtan tshad med dang*/ / gzugs med snyoms 'jug rnam thar snyoms 'jug dgu/ /rnam thar sgo gsum ting 'dzin gzungs kyi sgo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu mi 'jigs bzhi/ /so sor rig bzhi byams chen snying rje che/ /ma 'dres bco brgyad mkhyen gsum 'phags rnams kyang*/

/kun rdzob 'dus byas lam bden 'di min gyi/ / 'di las gzhan mchog pha rol 'gog bden te/ /rgyu rkyen med cing 'pho 'gyur med pa dang*/ /cha med kun 'gro kun la khyab pa sogs/ /nam mkha' 'dus ma byas kyi dpe yis gsungs/ /rang gis mi stong gzhan gyis stong pa ni/ /grong stong bum pa stong sogs dpe yis gsungs/ /rtog la mi snang mi rtog ye shes la/ / mngon sum snang ba pra phab dpe yis gsungs/ /rang bzhin bde chen so sor rang rig ni/ /kun tu ru skyes bde ba'i dpe yis gsungs/ /bden gnyis rgya mnyam rnam pa mtshungs pa dang*/ /rnam pa mang zhing yon tan mang po dang*/ /dri ma'i sbubs su chud par dka' ba sogs/ /dar yug chen po'i dpe yis gsal bar gsungs/ /kun tu khyab cing mdun na rtag gnas kyang*/ /rnam shes kun gyis mthong ba med pa'i dpe/ /ling tog la sogs mig gi skyon rnams dang*/ / khron pa rko ba la sogs mang pos gsungs/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang lus med lus mchog sogs/ /'gal 'dus skyon med mang po ston pa'i dpe/ / 'jig rten 'di na yod min de yi phyir/ /'jig rten dpe las 'das so zhes pa dang*/ /dper bya kun las 'das zhes legs par gsungs/ /kun la yod kyang sems can nyon mongs kyis/ /bsgribs pa'i dpe ni bum nang mar me dang*/ / dbul por gter chen la sogs mang pos gsungs/ /dri ma sangs na mngon du gyur pa'i dpe/ /chu khams gser dang nam mkha' la sogs gsungs/ /dri ma zad kyang snying po mi zad pa'i/ /dpe yang nam mkha' la sogs mang pos gsungs/ /mthar thug gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbyer med cing*/ /rang bzhin rnam dag nyid du khyad med kyang*/ /dri bcas gzhi dang dri bral 'bras bu zhes/ /sprin yod sprin med nam mkha'i dpe yis gsungs/ /nges don mthar thug zab mo'i gnas gyur kyang*/ /ngo bo mi 'gyur dri bcas dri med du/ /gyur pa dri bral 'bras bu thob pa ste/

/nam mkha'i sprin sangs gyur pa dpe yis gsungs/ /ji bzhin rdzogs par ston pa'i dpe med kyang*/ /phyogs tsam ston pa'i dpe ni mang po dang*/ /rgyu mtshan yang dag shin tu mang po yis/ /gshis lugs 'khrul lugs 'khrul spong 'khrul sangs dang*/ /sbyang gzhi sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs 'bras kyis/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu 'khor bcas bsdus pa dang*/ /lta sgom spyod pa rnam dag bsdus pa'i don/ /rdzogs ldan chos las gsal bar gsungs mod kyang*/ /gsum ldan mar bcad de 'dra'i rnam gzhag nyams/ /gshis lugs ji bzhin rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/ /gnas lugs ji bzhin mthong ba'i sgom pa ni/ /phal cher nyams kyang bsod nams cher bsags pa'i/ /skyes mchog rnams la nyams myong bzang po dang*/ /spyod pa bzang po mnga' ba'ang mang du byon/ /de rnams la ni bdag kyang thal mo sbyor/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs stobs smon lam sogs/ /dge ba sgrub pa ji snyed mchis rnams la/ /bdag kyang dga' bas rjes su yi rang zhing*/ /dad dang gus pa'i gtsug gis phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad cing gus pa dang*// rten gsum la yang dad cing gus pa yis/ /zhabs tog bkur sti phu dud mdzad rnams la/ /rang gzhan sbyor bar mdzad pa rnams la'ang dad/ /sems can thams cad drin can pha ma dang*/ /sangs rgyas snying po can du nges rtogs nas/ / byams dang snying rjes bdag gzhan brje ba dang*/ /kun la ston pa bzhin du gus rnams la/ /bsam pa thag pas bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang grags 'di kun gshis kyi gnas lugs la/ /ri bong rwa bzhin gtan nas ma grub kyang*/ /tha snyad 'khrul ngor rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin/ /snang stong zung 'jug dbyer med rtogs pa dang*/ /rgyu 'bras slu ba med par rtogs pa yis/ /las ngan spong zhing las bzang legs bsgrubs nas/ /'gro kun bsgral phyir smon lam mchog sgrub la/

/de rnams kun gyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len/ /kun rdzob chos kun rang rang ngo bo yis/ /stong par rtogs nas med bzhin snang ba yi/ /brtan g.yo 'di kun 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig tu/ /legs par rtogs nas zhen chags mi mdzad pa'i// skyes mchog rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag 'dzin las byung nyon mongs rnam rtog kun/ /dgra bzhin rtogs nas rab tu 'dul mdzad cing*/ /zhi zhing dul bar gnas pa rnams la'ang dad/ /'dod chags gnyen por mi sdug pa dang ni/ /zhe sdang gnyen por byams pa bsgom pa dang*/ /gti mug gnyen por rten cing 'brel 'byung dang*/ /nga rgyal gnyen por khams kyi rab dbye dang*/ / rnam rtog gnyen por dbugs kyi 'byung 'jug sogs/ /spang bya so so'i gnyen por rab bsgoms nas/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog dgra las rnam rgyal ba'i/ /skyes mchog rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam shes bzhon pa las rlung 'gyu ba rnams/ /dbu mar ye shes rlung du bsgyur mdzad pa/ /rnam par mi rtog gnyis med ye shes kyi/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang kun rdzob glo bur dri ma yis/ /snang ba 'khrul snang kho nar legs rtogs nas/ /'di las gzhan mchog pha rol don dam gyis/ /snang ba mngon du gyur la bdag dad lags/ /pha yul nye 'brel nor rdzas la sogs pa/ /chags sdang skye ba'i dngos kun rab spangs nas/ /phyogs med ris med zhen chags med pa'i gnas/ / chos spyod gang 'phel bstan pa rnams la'ang dad/ /nor gyi so tshis 'du 'god rab spangs nas/ /sgo gsum dge ba'i phyogs su rab bkol te/ /'khor gsum dag pas smon lam mchog bsgrubs nas/ /dge ba'i nor mang spel ba rnams la'ang dad/ /'bad rtsol med par ngang gis byung ba yi/ /longs spyod g.yo ba snying po med rnams kyang*/ /yar gyi zhing dang mar gyi zhing dag la/ /legs par btang nas snying po len la'ang dad/ /rdzogs ldan chos mchog khyad par 'phags rnams la/

/yi ger 'bri sogs chos spyod rnam pa bcu/ /legs par sgrub cing bsgrub tu 'jug pa dang*/ /gzhan dag bskul bar mdzad par rnams la'ang dad/ /mkhan slob bla ma dge ba'i bshes rnams dang*/ /grogs mched la sogs chos mdzad thams cad kyis/ /skyon la mi rtog skyon nas mi brjod cing*// phrag dog med par dad gus mdzad la'ang dad/ /chos med sdig can lam log zhugs rnams la/ /phan sems chen pos legs pa'i gros 'debs shing*/ /lam bzang zhugs nas dge ba sgrub rnams la/ /dga' ba'i rjes su yi rang mdzad la'ang dad/ /mnyam bzhag zab mo la zlo'i skabs su ni/ /chos kyang spang na chos min lta ci smos/ /rjes thob shan 'byed skabs su yod med sogs/ /legs par phye nas ston mdzad rnams la'ang dad/ /zhu bde 'gyur bcas gang yin spang bya dang*/ /zhu bde 'gyur med gang yin bsten bya dang*/ /rang bzhin 'gyur med gang yin thob byar ni/ /legs rtogs legs sgrub legs ston rnams la'ang dad/ /mdor na rdzogs ldan chos dang mthun pa yi/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu lta sgom spyod pa rnams/ /legs rtogs legs sgrub legs par ston mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can la brten nas/ /thams cad rang stong nyid du bzhed pa dang*/ /rang stong don dam yin par bzhed pa dang*/ /don dam rang stong yin par bzhed pa dang*/ /rnam rtog chos sku yin par bzhed pa dang*/ /dug lnga ye shes yin par bzhed pa dang*/ /rnam shes sangs rgyas yin par bzhed pa dang*/ /las snang sangs rgyas yin par bzhed pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas ming stong tsam du bzhed pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas gtan nas med par bzhed pa dang*/ /don dam sangs rgyas med par bzhed pa dang*/

/ bden gnyis ngo bo gcig tu bzhed pa dang*/ /'khor 'das ngo bo gcig par bzhed pa dang*/ /spang gnyen ngo bo gcig par bzhed pa dang*/ /sbyang bya sbyang gzhi gcig tu bzhed pa dang*/ /kun 'byung las byung sdug bsngal 'khor ba 'di/ / rtogs na sangs rgyas ma rtogs 'khor ba zhes/ /bzhed pa rnams la bdag ni ma phod pas/ /bya gtong bzhin tu legs pa'i skad 'dir gtong*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byon rung ma byon rung*/ /yongs grub dgu ni rtag tu de bzhin du/ / 'gyur ba med pa nyid du gnas so zhes/ /rdzogs ldan chos las gsungs pa dgongs su gsol/ /nyon mongs rnam rtog rnam shes tshogs 'di yang*/ /rtogs na chos sku ma rtogs dri ma zhes/ /bzhed pa rnams la bdag ni ma phod pas/ / rdzogs ldan chos dang mthun par mdzod cig ces/ /thal mo sbyar nas skad gtong gros 'debs so/ /rtogs na gser yin ma rtogs ra gan yin/ /rtogs na rta yin ma rtogs ba lang yin/ /rtogs na snang ba ma rtogs mun pa yin/ /rtogs na sman yin ma rtogs dug yin zhes/ /'dod pa rnams dang khyad par ci mchis gzigs/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i lung rigs man ngag kyang*/ /rnam dag mchis na bdag la'ang bstan du gsol/ /thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral yin no zhes/ / bzhed pa rnams la'ang bdag ni ma phod pas/ /thal mo sbyar nas skad gtong gros 'debs te/ /kun gzhi ye shes de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhi dang gnas dang rten/ /cha med kun 'gro kun khyab yin par ni/ / rdzogs ldan chos las gsungs pa'ang dgongs su gsol/ /shes bya thams cad dngos po dngos med du/ /kha tshon chod par bzhed pa thams cad dang*/ /bem rig gang yin dngos por bzhed rnams la'ang*/ /bdag ni thal mo sbyar nas skad gtong ste/ /gshis lugs mthar thug phung po gsum pa dang*/ /dbus ma bar ma ma ning mchog tu gsungs/ /'dus ma byas kyi bde ba shes pa dang*/ /ye shes rig pa phung po khams la sogs/

/gzugs nas ma 'dres chos kyi bar dang ni/ /rtag brtan ther zug g.yung drung mi 'gyur ba'i/ /gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos kun dang*/ /chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i yongs grub kyi/ /gzugs nas sangs rgyas chos kyi bar rnams kyang*/ /shes bya'i mthar thug don dam bden pa yin/ /'dus ma byas yin 'dus byas dngos po min/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i gzhung mchog gzigs su gsol/ /kun rdzob 'di las gzhan mchog pha rol gyi/ /ro dang khams kyi rnam 'gyur so drug dang*/ /phung po'i rnam 'gyur sum cu rtsa drug dang*/ /phung po khams sogs sum cu drug la sogs/ / shes bya'i mthar thug de bzhin nyid yin yang*/ /dngos po dngos med gang yang ma yin par/ /gsungs pa'i gzhung mchog rnams kyang gzigs su gsol/ / bden pa yang dag med par bzhed rnams la'ang*/ /bdag ni ma phod skad gtong gros 'debs te/ /myang 'das chen po bden par gsungs pa dang*/ /'gog bden bden pa'i mchog tu gsungs pa dang*/ /de bzhin nyid bden gzhan ni brdzun pa dang*/ /bden don bcu gnyis la sogs gshis lugs kyi/ /bden pa mthar thug rdzogs ldan chos las gsungs/ /de dag rnams kyang legs par gzigs su gsol/ /rtag par rtogs tshad rtag lta'i skyon can dang*/ /chad par rtogs tshad chad lta'i skyon can dang*/ /yod par rtogs tshad yod lta'i skyon can dang*/ /med par rtogs tshad med lta'i skyon can du/ /bzhed pa rnams la'ang bdag ni ma phod pas/ /thal mo sbyar nas bya gtong gros 'debs te/ /rtag par rtogs la skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /mi rtag rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /gtsang bar rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /mi gtsang rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /bde bar rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /sdug bsngal rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /bdag yod rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /bdag med rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/

/yod par rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /med par rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /chad par rtogs la'ang skyon dang yon tan gnyis/ /rdzogs ldan chos las gsungs pas gzigs su gsol/ /gshis la sangs rgyas med par bzhed pa dang*/ /'dus ma byas kyi sangs rgyas mi bzhed cing*/ /rtag brtan ther zug sangs rgyas mi bzhed pa/ /de rnams la yang bdag gis ma phod pas/ /thal mo sbyar nas gros 'debs zhu ba phul/ /don dam bden pa dbyings rig dbyer med ni/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas gzhi yi sangs rgyas te/ /rtag brtan ther zug g.yung drung mkha' khyab kyi/ /de bzhin nyid la sangs rgyas byang chub ces/ /rdzogs ldan las gsungs de yang gzigs su gsol/ / gshis la ye shes med par 'dod pa dang*/ /rang byung ye shes rtag par mi bzhed pa/ /de rnams la ni bdag yang zhu ba 'bul/ /skad cig gcig dang du ma bral ba yi/ /ye shes la ni rgyal ba mchog rnams kyis/ /de kho na nyid ces ni rdzogs ldan gyi/ /chos las gsungs pas de dag gzigs su gsol/ /bde gshegs snying po drang don yin no zhes/ /bzhed pa rnams la'ang bdag ni ma phod pas/ / thal mo sbyar nas skad gtong zhu ba 'bul/ /bde gshegs snying po de bzhin nyid yin zhing*/ /de bzhin nyid kyang bde gshegs snying yin pas/ /bde gshegs snying po drang don yin na ni/ /de bzhin nyid kyang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /don dam chos sku'ang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /ngo bo nyid sku'ang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /rang bzhin rigs kyang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /sher phyin zab mo'ang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /dbu ma chen po'ang drang don yin par 'gyur// myang 'das chen po'ang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po'ang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /'od gsal chen po'ang drang don yin par 'gyur/ /bde dgyes dus 'khor gsang 'dus la sogs pa/ /gshis lugs zab mo'i lha sngags dkyil 'khor dang*/

/rgyud dang phyag rgya mthar thug thams cad kyang*/ / drang don yin par ha cang thal bas gnod/ /bde gshegs snying po drang don yin par ni/ /ston pa'i lung rigs mchis na bstan du gsol/ /nges don yin par ston pa'i lung rigs dang*/ /man ngag zab mo shin tu mang bar mchis/ /gal te la la'i log rtog 'di snyam du/ /bde gshegs snying po drang don ma yin yang*/ / de yi yon tan thams cad drang don yin/ /de phyir yon tan mang po tshang ba yi/ / bde gshegs snying po don la med ce na/ /rgyal ba'i yum las yongs grub rnam dgu po/ /re re'i yon tan la yang tshad med ces/ /legs par gsungs shing snying po'i mdo bcu dang*/ /nges don mdo bcu la sogs rdzogs ldan gyi/ /chos gzhan las kyang don dam rtag pa yi/ /yon tan bgrang yas gsungs pas gzigs su gsol/ /gal te sangs rgyas rtag pa mi srid pas/ /rtag par gsungs pa drang don yin zhe na/ /'o na 'dus ma byas su gsungs pa yang*/ /drang don yin nam min zhes khyed la 'dri/ /'dus ma byas dang rtag pa khyab mnyam gcig /mi rtag pa dang 'dus byas khyab mnyam gcig /des na gcig khegs gnyis ka khegs 'gyur bas/ /rtag pa khegs nas 'dus ma byas khegs phyir/ / don dam chos kyi dbyings kyang khegs 'gyur bas/ /e ma chos rnams thams cad khegs par 'gyur/ /khyab byed khegs na khyab bya khegs phyir dang*/ /rten khegs na yang brten pa khegs phyir dang*/ /don dam rten dang kun rdzob brten pa dang*/ /chos nyid rten dang chos rnams brten pa dang*/ /don dam khyab byed kun rdzob khyab bya dang*/ /dbus mtha' la sogs rten dang brten pa dang*/ /khyab byed khyab byar gnas pa shin tu mang*/ /de rnams kun la zhib tu dgongs par zhu/ / bde gshegs snying pos 'gro kun yongs la khyab/ /ces sogs khyab byed khyab bya mang po dang*/ /rten dang brten pa mang po gsungs rnams la/ /khyab byed khegs na khyab bya khegs pa dang*/

/rten med gyur na brten pa med pa'ang dgongs/ / gal te sangs rgyas rtag pa mi srid na/ /de yi shes byed lung rigs bstan du gsol/ /srid pa la ni lung rigs dpag yas mchis/ /rang ngo shes pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir/ /tshogs gnyis gsog dang sgrib gnyis sbyong mi dgos/ / rang ngo shes pas ma spangs gnas dag ces/ /bzhed pa rnams la'ang bdag ni ma phod pas/ /thal mo sbyar nas gros 'debs zhu ba 'bul/ /rang rig med pa'i sems can mi srid cing*/ /rang rig yon na rang ngo shes pa yod/ /gal de rang gzhan gang yang mi rig na/ /rig pa yin par 'gal te 'byung chen bzhin/ /de phyir sems can kun la sems yod cing*/ /sems yod kun la rang rig yod pa'i phyir/ /rang ngo shes pa skyes tsam nyid nas yod/ /tshul 'di lung rigs mkhyen pa rnams la grags/ /blun po thos chung mngon pa'i nga rgyal can/ /chos la dbang za gzu lum rang bzo mkhan/ /shin tu mang yang tshul 'di rtogs pa'am// thos dang mthong ba tsam yang yod re skan/ /de phyir rang ngo shes pas chog pa yi// lta log de 'dra bdud kyi gsang tshig yin/ /de ltar rtogs dang ma rtogs pa las ni/ /yang dag lam dang log pa'i lam du 'jug /de phyir rang ngo shes pas gol zhes pa'i/ /sdig lta bdud las de 'dra spong gyur cig /gal te rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i don/ /rang sems rnam shes 'di ni chos kyi sku/ /yin par rtogs pa nyid la byed ce na/ /rnam shes 'di ni chos sku'i mi mthun phyogs/ /yin phyir chos sku gtan nas ma yin no/ /gal te yin na dug kyang bdud rtsi 'am/ /mun nag stug po'ang snang ba yin nam ci/ /nag phyogs rnams kyang dkar phyogs yin nam ci/ /spang bya rnams kyang gnyen po yin nam ci/ /gshed ma rnams kyang gnyen mchog yin nam ci/ /bdud rigs rnams kyang bla ma yin nam ci/ /sdig pa thams cad dge ba yin nam ci/ /ngan 'gro thams cad bde 'gro yin nam ci/

/ 'dus byas thams cad rtag pa yin nam ci/ /'khor ba thams cad bde ba yin nam ci/ /rnam shes thams cad ye shes yin nam ci/ /'dzag bcas thams cad 'dzag med yin nam ci/ /bcos ma thams cad rang bzhin yin nam ci/ /glo bur thams cad gnyug ma yin nam ci/ /dri ma thams cad snying po yin nam ci/ / kun rdzob thams cad don dam yin nam ci/ /chos rnams thams cad chos nyid yin nam ci/ /las gzugs thams cad 'od gsal yin nam ci/ /skyon rnams thams cad yon tan yin nam ci/ /byur ngan thams cad dpal chen yin nam ci/ /nyes pa thams cad legs pa yin nam ci/ /dma' mo thams cad mthon po yin nam ci/ /ngan pa thams cad bzang po yin nam ci/ /ring ba thams cad nye ba yin nam ci/ /zag bcas thams cad zag med yin nam ci/ /thogs bcas thams cad thogs med yin nam ci/ /gzugs can thams cad gzugs med yin nam ci/ /bstan yod thams cad bstan med yin nam ci/ /drang don thams cad nges don yin nam ci/ /chos log thams cad chos mchog yin nam ci/ / lam log thams cad lam mchog yin nam ci/ /g.yang sa thams cad bde sa yin nam ci/ /nag po thams cad dkar po yin nam ci/ /gru bzhi thams cad zlum po yin nam ci/ /mdog dbyibs gzhan rnams la yang mtshungs par sbyar// de 'dra'i shes bya thams cad la yang sbyar/ /gang phyir chos sku'i mi mthun phyogs yin yang*/ /chos sku yin na rig pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ /'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi chos kun la/ /tshul 'di rigs pa 'di 'dra mkhas pas rig /blun po rang bzo mkhan gyi spyod yul min/ /gal te rang sems rnam shes tshogs 'di dag /chos sku min na stong nyid min par 'gyur/ /chos dbyings min na'ang stong nyid min par 'gyur/ /chos nyid min na'ang stong nyid min par 'gyur/ /de skad smra na blun rtags bstan pa yin/ /gang phyir stong pa nyid dang chos sku la/ /mu gnyis yod kyi khyab mnyam gtan ma yin/ /chos dbyings la sogs yongs grub thams cad dang*/

/stong pa nyid la mu gnyis yod pa yi/ /man ngag zab mos dben zhing log bshad kyi/ /dug chus rab tu myos pa'i rlabs bcol lo/ /de phyir mu gnyis mu gsum mu bzhi yis/ /chos kun gtan la 'bebs pa'i rdzogs ldan dang*/ /rnam pa kun tu 'bral bar ma gyur cig /gsum ldan mar bcad skyon can rnams na re/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ye shes ming tsam yin/ /yon tan mang po gsungs pa'ang drang don yin/ /de phyir rten gsum bzhengs pa don med de/ /zhor la sems can 'chi zhing bzhengs pa yi/ /dge ba bas kyang zhig pa'i sdig pa lci/ /sa ni sdig med mchod rten sdig can yin/ /des na dge ba rjes can ma byed par/ /mchod pa thams cad kha la rab phul nas/ /dge ba thams cad rjes med gyis shig ces/ /gsungs pa rnams la'ang bdag ni ma phod pas// thal mo sbyar nas gros 'debs zhu ba 'bul/ /don dam sangs rgyas don dam bden par yod/ /de yi byin gyis brlabs dang dge tshogs las/ /legs par 'khrungs pa'i kun rdzob sangs rgyas kyang*/ /kun rdzob tsam tu yod par rgyal bas gsungs/ /kun rdzob sangs rgyas rang stong yin mod kyang*/ /nor bu dpag bsam shing bzhin gzhan phan 'byung*/ /don dam chos sku yon tan dpag yas pas/ /rgyal sras mchog dang dgra bcom dpag yas la/ /gzhan don mdzad par rdzogs ldan chos las gsungs/ /de 'dra ma thos ma mthong rang bzo mkhan// gzu lum mkhan gyis rgyal la skur btab pas/ /de yi rten gsum la yang skur btab nas/ /dge ba'i sgo chen mang po rab tu bkag /de rnams kyis kyang rdzogs ldan chos mchog rnams/ /myur du mthong nas lta ngan rab spangs te/ / dge ba'i sgo chen mang du 'byed gyur cig /rgyal ba skyon med yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ /de phyir de la phan gnod gang byas pa'i/ /'bras bu gzhan las lhag par che bar gsungs/ /de phyir ched du gtad nas bshig na ni/ /sdig chen 'gyur gyi rang bzhin zhig pa ni/

/sdig chen yin par gsungs pa ma mthong ngo*/ / bdag ni skye ba thams cad du/ /bstan pa gsal bar byed gyur cig /bstan pa gsal bar ma nus na'ang*/ /bstan pa'i khur chen 'khur bar shog /khur chen 'khur bar ma nus na'ang*/ /bstan pa'i sems khral byed pa dang*/ /bstan pa nyams kyis dogs pa yis/ /bya ra tsam yang byed par shog /mkha' khyab pha ma thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /sdug bsngal sel bar ma nus na'ang*/ /sdug grogs tsam yang byed par shog /ngo bo nyid gsum 'dod dang mi 'dod las/ /sems tsam dbu mar log bshad byed pa dang*/ /kun gzhi rnam shes 'dod dang mi 'dod las/ /sems tsam dbu mar log bshad byed pa dang*/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad 'dod dang mi 'dod las/ /sems tsam dbu mar log bshad byed pa dang*/ /rigs chad 'dod dang mi 'dod pa las kyang*/ / sems tsam dbu mar log bshad byed la sogs/ /rdzogs ldan chos dang 'gal ba'i log bshad rnams/ /bdag gzhan kun gyis rtag tu spong gyur cig/ //bka' bsdu bzhi pa'i don bstan rtsis chen po zhes bya ba phyogs med ris med kyi bstan bcos 'di ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas gnang sbyin bzang la mang ba mdzad de/ 'di lta bu'i bstan bcos mang du rtsoms gsungs pa la brten nas/ rton pa bzhi ldan gyis sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so//
